title: The Ryuo's Work Is Never Done Light Novels' 21st, Final Volume Listed With July 15 Release
content: SB Creative is lsiting the 21st and final volume of Shirow Shiratori 's The Ryuo's Work Is Never Done! light novel series with a July 15 release date. SB Creative 's GA Bunko light novel label revealed on January 4 earlier this year that the 21st volume will be the final volume.
author: ANN

title: U-NEXT Holdings to Acquire GoHands Anime Studio as 100%-Owned Subsidiary
content: Through this acquisition, U-NEXT Holdings aims to integrate U-NEXT (formerly GyaO! NEXT, self-described as Japan's biggest streaming platform) with the high-quality animation production capacity of GoHands .
author: ANN

title: One Piece Reveals Fan-Favorite Straw Hat’s Surprise Origin After 19 Years
content: Warning! Major spoilers for One Piece Chapter 1183 to follow! One Piece has reached a new phase of the Elbaph arc as the series’ greatest villain has made their move at last, and the newest chapter is digging deep into the past with a surprising new origin story for one of the Straw Hats.

title: Webtoon-Based Live-Action Movie Purge List Confirms Production, Lead Cast
content: Korean news outlet JTBC reported on Friday that a live-action film adaptation of the webtoon Purge List ( Salsaengbu ) is in development. The outlet also confirmed the lead cast featuring Woo-sung Jung , Sung-il Jung, and Ha-joon Wi.
author: ANN

title: Major Netflix Anime Confirms Release Date for Next Season 2 Update
content: A major Shonen Jump anime is gearing up for its return to Netflix with a second season later this year, and has revealed when the next major update for the new episodes is on the way. It’s been a big year for anime on Netflix so far, and it’s likely going to be an even bigger year as 2026 continues with the platform.
author: ComicBook

title: Historie Anime Reveals New Trailer, Visual, Main Cast & January 2027 Release
content: The anime adaptation of Parasyte creator’s Historie revealed the first trailer and new teaser visual, along with the main voice cast and January 2027 release date. Studio LIDEN FILMS is in charge of the animation, as announced on January 1 with the initial teaser visual and trailer.
author: Anime Corner

title: Game Developer M2 Cancels Ubusuna Shooting Game
content: Game developer M2 and the company's Representative Director Naoki Horii announced on Sunday that the development of M2's Ubusuna shooting game has been canceled, following the resignation of game creator Hiroshi Iuchi ( Ikaruga , Radiant Silvergun ), the lead of the team developing the game.
author: ANN

title: Historie Anime's 1st Promo Video Reveals 11 Cast Members
content: The official website for LIDEN FILMS ' television anime of Hitoshi Iwaaki 's Historie manga unveiled on Monday the anime's first promotional video, second teaser visual, and 11 cast members. It was announced earlier that Nobunaga Shimazaki will star in the series as protagonist Eumenes.
author: ANN

title: You and I Are Polar Opposites Season 2 Reveals Opening Song in New Trailer
content: You and I Are Polar Opposites Season 2 anime revealed the second trailer, introducing the opening theme song “nekojarashi” by 7co. The second season was announced on March 29, and it is set to premiere on July 5, 2026. Studio Lapin Track ( Undead Girl Murder Farce ) is animating. You can watch the new trailer below.
author: Anime Corner
